one_line_product_description: Document Protocol Lab is an interactive casebook for bounded document-comparison judgment: what a workflow should claim, how it should prove it, and where it should stop.
short_subhead: Current live casebook: six curated SEC Item 1A cases anchored by NVDA, LLY, and KO.
current_coverage_statement: The current visible casebook covers six public Item 1A cases: NVDA, LLY, KO, META, TSLA, and WMT.
three_case_mix_usefulness_statement: NVDA, LLY, and KO teach vivid answer, honest stop, and useful restraint; META, TSLA, and WMT add sharper pressure around AI enforcement, policy shock, and retail interface risk.
where_to_start_statement: Start with NVDA for the clearest answer-first read, LLY for honest stop, KO for restraint, or open the Casebook for the full six-case roster.
external_demo_blurb: Document Protocol Lab ships as a curated six-case interactive casebook for bounded document comparison.
readme_blurb: Document Protocol Lab ships as a bounded six-case casebook rather than a broad filing browser.
